items.title: Where Go 1.27's HTTP/1 Connection Reuse Stops Working
items.blurb: Go 1.27 now drains an unread HTTP/1 response body so the connection can be reused. I counted dials on Go 1.26 and 1.27, and found where the fix stops working.
